crossRefs.note: Then Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves of bread, two containers of wine, five sheep ready dressed, five seahs…
Now therefore, my lord, as Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, since Yahweh has withheld you from blood guiltiness…
Now this present which your servant has brought to my lord, let it be given to the young men who follow my lord.

translations.web: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.
translations.bsb: She brings him good and not harm all the days of her life.
translations.kjv: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.
translations.asv: She doeth him good and not evil All the days of her life.
